core_obligations: Use the abelian adjunction (proof lines 4556-4565): the author recalls that extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction on the level of modules, which gives the adjunction between the corresponding functors on the categories of complexes.

Pass to the derived categories (proof lines 4565-4575): since restriction is exact, the derived functors are computed by the same functors, and the adjunction of complexes descends to an adjunction between the derived categories, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Recall the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction at the level of modules.
Use exactness of restriction to identify the derived functors.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that on the derived categories, extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction along the localization morphism attached to an object of a ringed site (statement lines 4546-4554). The proof recalls the abelian adjunction (proof lines 4556-4565) and then passes to the derived categories, using exactness of restriction so that no derived functor has to be computed beyond the given functors (proof lines 4565-4575). The non-formal content is the passage from the abelian adjunction to the derived one. The claim is H2: one adjunction upgraded through exactness.
